source_text: Ego sum Dominus Deus tuus qui eduxi te de terra Aegypti. Non solum patribus, sed tibi si exis de Aegypto vitiorum. Praesens saeculum Aegyptus figuraliter.
pass_a_gloss: I am Lord God your who led-out you from land of-Egypt. Not only to-fathers, but to-you if you-exit from Egypt of-vices. Present age Egypt figuratively.
pass_b_english: [[I am the Lord your God who brought you out of the land of Egypt >> Bible:Exodus 20:2]]. Not only to the fathers — to you, if you leave the Egypt of the vices. This present age is Egypt in figure.
